lines.text: Balaam turned his face toward the wilderness instead of seeking omens, and the Spirit of God came upon him.
Balaam said Israel's tents were lovely, and that God brought them out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox.
Balak struck his hands together in anger and told Balaam to flee home after he blessed Israel four times.
Balaam said a star would come forth from Jacob and crush the skulls of Edom, and that Amalek's end is destruction.
Balaam said Asshur would take the Kenites captive, and then he returned to his homeland while Balak went on his way.
